data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **1Password Business** is my top recommendation. It offers an excellent balance of security, ease of use, centralized administration, and secure sharing.

However, the best choice depends on your team size, budget, and how much administrative control you need.

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password: Password Manager | Apps | Godly](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9Onad3ZmM68M7l5dTIbPMn43a-YB12X_e9tFS-w_jdjYbB1mwCcSBgDwHjfxiov3sFv56iK_BYB0DBDy1ElBpKTj_x8BM6wjwBy4mijsixFzsgcbh4l6IAVcN_W3xEYaPv3HJbWtjoYtl68hPIh1Q4uMTSZR5QKnTsp4CKPumigoRyeUfSzM6z8piMAIIqVa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent, intuitive apps
- Shared vaults with granular permissions
- Secure password sharing
- Security alerts and admin controls
- Great for nontechnical employees

Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for 10 users, billed annually. Business: \$8.99/user/month.

[Official pricing and plans](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundation
- Secure shared collections
- Audit and event logs
- Directory synchronization and SCIM
- Self-hosting available on Enterprise

Teams: \$4/user/month. Enterprise: \$6/user/month, billed annually.

[Official pricing and plans](https://bitwarden.com/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

(Best for administrative controls)

- Shared team folders
- Delegated administration
- Strong access policies
- Useful for security-conscious businesses

Business pricing varies by plan.

[Official website](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

(Best for security monitoring)

- Password health monitoring
- Phishing protection features
- Centralized administration
- Useful security reporting

Business pricing depends on the current offering.

[Official website](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to these two\:

| What matters most | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Ease of use and adoption | 1Password |
| Affordability | Bitwarden |
| Advanced administration | 1Password Business |
| Self-hosting | Bitwarden Enterprise |


For a typical small business, I'd start with 1Password Teams Starter Pack if you have 10 or fewer employees. If cost is a bigger consideration, Bitwarden Teams is an excellent alternative.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can make a more specific recommendation with three details\:

**1\. How many people need access?**

---

**2\. What's your monthly budget?**

---

**3\. What will you primarily store?**

---

**4\. What does your company use?**
